input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination amount on Client, so it meets the preferred position. Client may elect to terminate under Section 14 with services (and therefore fees) simply running to the last day of the following month, and Section 13 non-renewal requires only 30 days' notice — neither triggers any fixed or minimum payment on exit. Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "damages", "fee", and dollar amounts return only ordinary compensation terms: the Section 5 minimum monthly amounts ("but not less than $____ per month") are consideration for services actually provided during the term, not a sum payable on termination or on breach, and Exhibits A and B contain only charges for services. The only monetary caps/liability provisions (p0077) limit TrueLink's exposure and do not create Client-payable stipulated sums. Note for the record: the minimum monthly fee blanks and the Section 6 bar on contesting "the minimum monthly fees" are commercial points for the fee negotiation (and the internal cross-reference to "Section 4" appears to be a mis-citation to Section 5), but they are not liquidated damages and are not redlined under this rule.
